path.style: fill: none; stroke: #002060; stroke-width: 4.5; stroke-linecap: square
fill: none; stroke: #002060; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: square
fill: none; stroke: #002060; stroke-width: 2.5; stroke-linecap: square
fill: none; stroke: #94a3b8; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: square
fill: none; stroke: #002060; stroke-width: 3.5; stroke-linecap: square

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 23px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: Algorithm 1:

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 20.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: PQC Network Bandwidth & Latency Overhead Profiler

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: Input:

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: API Traces T = { (e_i, C_i, tps_i, L_base,i) } for i = 1, ..., N

text.style: font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Target PQC Primitives: KEM K (e.g., ML-KEM-768), Signature S (e.g., ML-DSA-65)

text.style: font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Hardware Specs: PubKeySize(c), SigSize(c), Ethernet MTU = 1500 bytes

text.style: font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Operational Constraints: Bank SLA Limit = 50.0 ms, Expansion Threshold = 3.0x

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: Output:

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Sizing Assessment Matrix M = { (e_i, tps_i, BW_leg, BW_pqc, Gamma_i, Phi_i, L_pqc, Risk_i) }

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Initialize empty output assessment matrix: M <- []

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Extract Target PQC Key & Signature Sizes from Specification:

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: S_pqc <- PubKeySize(K) + SigSize(S) // ML-KEM-768 + ML-DSA-65: 1184 + 3300 = 4484 B

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Compute PQC Handshake MTU Packet Fragmentation Factor:

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Phi_pqc <- ceil( S_pqc / MTU ) // ceil( 4484 / 1500 ) = 3 TCP packets

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: for each trace t_i in API Traces T do

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: C_leg <- t_i.C_i // e.g., RSA-2048 or ECDSA-P256

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: S_leg <- PubKeySize(C_leg) + SigSize(C_leg) // e.g., 256 + 256 = 512 bytes

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Phi_leg <- ceil( S_leg / MTU ) // ceil( 512 / 1500 ) = 1 TCP packet

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-style: italic; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #059669

g.text: // Compute Ingress Bandwidth Requirements in Megabytes/sec (MB/s)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: BW_leg <- ( t_i.tps_i * S_leg ) / ( 1024 * 1024 )

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: BW_pqc <- ( t_i.tps_i * S_pqc ) / ( 1024 * 1024 )

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Gamma_i <- BW_pqc / max( 1.0, BW_leg ) // Bandwidth Expansion Scale Factor

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-style: italic; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #059669

g.text: // Model TCP Multi-Packet Serialization Latency & Network Overhead

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Delta_L <- ( Phi_pqc - Phi_leg ) * 2.2 ms + ( S_pqc / MTU ) * 1.5 ms

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: L_pqc <- t_i.L_base,i + Delta_L // Projected Post-Quantum Handshake Latency

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-style: italic; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #059669

g.text: // Evaluate Banking Service Level Agreement (SLA) & Bottleneck Risk

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: if ( Gamma_i > 3.0 ) OR ( L_pqc > 50.0 ms ) then

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #dc2626

g.text: Risk_i <- CRITICAL_RISK ( Handshake Latency Spike & HSM Deficit )

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: else

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #16a34a

g.text: Risk_i <- COMPLIANT_MANAGED ( Within Latency Budget & Capacity )

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: end if

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Record_i <- ( t_i.e_i, t_i.tps_i, BW_leg, BW_pqc, Gamma_i, Phi_pqc, L_pqc, Risk_i )

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: M.append( Record_i )

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: end for

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: return M

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: Complexity Analysis:

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 15.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #334155

g.text: Time Complexity: O(N) linear scan over API endpoints | Space Complexity: O(N) for assessment matrix M
